exposure: Maternal feed restriction during pregnancy (16, 12, 9, or 6 g/rat/day)
outcome: Phorbol myristate-acetate solution-induced hydrogen peroxide release by inflammatory cells
Humoral immune response against sheep red blood cells
cohort: Pregnant Wistar rats distributed into five groups: one control group fed ad libitum and four experimental groups fed restricted amounts of rodent ration from the 6th to 17th gestation day.
finding: Maternal feed restriction during organogenesis in Wistar rats did not cause structural malformations but led to offspring with lower birth weights and significant changes in immune responses.
birth_weight: Lower birth weights observed in offspring of feed-restricted mothers
